trace.msg: Let's look at this puzzle carefully. I'll only move when I can explain why.
Going to (6,4,7) would leave number 2 unreachable without crossing a higher number. So the line goes to (7,4,4).
Number 2 is only reachable this way.
Number 3 is only reachable this way.
The line must go to (6,6,7): to (6,7,6) is number 5, which comes later.
Number 4 is only reachable this way.
Going to (2,6,7) would leave number 5 unreachable without crossing a higher number. So the line goes to (4,7,6).
Number 5 is next and right here, so the line takes it.
Going to (7,6,2) would leave number 7 unreachable without crossing a higher number; going to (6,6,1) would leave number 7 unreachable without crossing a higher number. So the line goes to (4,7,2).
Going to (2,7,2) would strand number 7: it would be left with only one free neighbour. So the line goes to (4,7,4).
Only one free cell next to the line, so it goes to (2,7,4).
Going to (2,7,2), every way of continuing runs into a dead end within a few moves. So the line goes to (1,6,4).
Going to (1,6,6) would force the line onto number 22 before its turn. So the line goes to (1,6,2).
Cell (2,7,2) has only two exits, so the line must pass through it now.
Only one free cell next to the line, so it goes to (2,6,1).
Going to (4,4,1), every way of continuing runs into a dead end within a few moves. So the line goes to (6,6,1).
Cell (7,6,2) has only two exits, so the line must pass through it now.
Only one free cell next to the line, so it goes to (7,4,2).
Going to (7,2,2), the next 5 moves are forced and the line gets stuck at cell (4,1,2). So the line goes to (6,4,1).
I can't rule out to (6,2,1) or to (4,4,1) yet, so I'll make an educated guess: to (6,2,1).
Going to number 12 leaves no safe move afterwards; going to (4,2,1) leaves no safe move afterwards. So the line goes to (7,2,2).
Number 12 is only reachable this way.
The line must go to (4,1,2): to (6,1,4) is number 16, which comes later.

Going to (2,1,2), the next 7 moves are forced and the line gets stuck at cell (1,2,4); going to (4,1,4), the next 9 moves are forced and the line gets stuck at cell (1,2,4). So the line goes to (4,2,1).
Cell (4,4,1) has only two exits, so the line must pass through it now.
Only one free cell next to the line, so it goes to (2,4,1).
Going to (1,4,2), the next 5 moves are forced and the line gets stuck at cell (1,2,4). So the line goes to (2,2,1).
Going to number 14 would leave both cell (1,4,2) and cell (2,1,2) needing the line next, and it can't do both. So the line goes to (2,1,2).
Going to (2,1,4), the next 3 moves are forced and the line gets stuck at cell (1,4,2). So the line goes to (1,2,2).
Cell (1,4,2) has only two exits, so the line must pass through it now.
Only one free cell next to the line, so it goes to (1,4,4).
Going to (1,4,6) would leave number 16 unreachable without crossing a higher number. So the line goes to (1,2,4).
The line must go to (2,1,4): to (1,2,6) is number 23, which comes later.
Going to (2,1,6) would leave number 16 unreachable without crossing a higher number. So the line goes to (4,1,4).
Number 16 is next and right here, so the line takes it.
Cell (7,2,4) has only two exits, so the line must pass through it now.
Only one free cell next to the line, so it goes to (7,2,6).
Going to number 18 would leave both cell (6,1,6) and cell (6,4,7) needing the line next, and it can't do both. So the line goes to (6,1,6).
Number 18 is next and right here, so the line takes it.
Cell (6,4,7) has only two exits, so the line must pass through it now.
Only one free cell next to the line, so it goes to (4,4,7).
Going to (2,4,7) would leave number 20 unreachable without crossing a higher number. So the line goes to (4,2,7).
Number 20 is next and right here, so the line takes it.
Going to (1,4,6) would wall in number 23, the last number. So the line goes to (2,6,7).
Going to (1,6,6) would turn number 22 into a dead-end pocket with no way out. So the line goes to (2,7,6).
Only one free cell next to the line, so it goes to (1,6,6).
Every cell is covered and the numbers are in order. Case closed!
